caption: A man sitting in a dining chair leans back until only the two rear legs are on the floor, leans a little further, and tips over backward with the chair.

sa.check: A man sits in a dining chair.
He leans back until only the rear legs are on the floor.
He and the chair tip over backward.
The front legs are off the floor before the tip.
The lean comes first, then the balance on two legs, then the fall.

pc.expect: The chair balances on its rear legs while he is near the tipping point; once past it the fall begins and speeds up.
pc.fail: The chair hangs balanced far past upright for the rest of the clip; or the fall slows as it goes; or he rises off the chair.

pc.expect: They fall backward together and land behind where the chair stood.
pc.fail: They fall forward; or the man falls and the chair stays upright; or they fall sideways.

pc.expect: Nothing pushes him; the tip comes from his own lean.
pc.fail: The chair tips before he leans; or it slides across the floor; or it rights itself after starting to fall.

pc.expect: The chair stays rigid in legs and back, and the floor takes the impact.
pc.fail: The chair legs bend; or the chair bounces high; or the man's body folds like cloth.

pc.expect: The man and the chair keep their number and shape, and neither passes into the other or the floor.
pc.fail: He merges with the chair; or a limb detaches; or the chair passes through the floor.

pc.expect: His clothing, the chair and the room stay the same.
pc.fail: His clothing changes colour; or the chair changes design between frames; or the room rearranges.

note: Balance scene: the man is kept because his body is the load that moves the balance point. His expression and how gracefully he falls are not judged.
